title: Gemini takes the wheel on your Mac
hook: 你坐在 Mac 前面空著雙手，螢幕裡一顆 Gemini 小星星已經坐進駕駛座。
bridge: 這輛自己開的車上了公路，路邊立著一排護欄，掛著暫停、停止、核准的牌子。
p: Google announced on Thursday, Nov. 19, that it is bringing computer use to its Gemini desktop app on macOS, TechCrunch reported. Once a user gives an instruction, Gemini can {0}: it works across local files, native Mac apps and websites while the user's screen and cursor stay free for other things.

Google says people can pause, stop and approve actions before they happen, a set of {1} for an agent that clicks around on its own. It is available only in English in the U.S., for Google AI Plus, Pro and Ultra subscribers. TechCrunch noted that OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta have offered similar agent features in their desktop apps for some time.

words.def: to take control of a task or situation, especially so someone else can step back
words.mn: 你的雙手離開了 Mac，Gemini 小星星坐進駕駛座，兩手握住方向盤，開始自己點檔案、填表單。接過方向盤，就是接手主導。
words.ex: When the project fell behind, our new manager took the wheel and reset the schedule.
words.exZh: 專案落後時，新來的經理接手主導，重新排了時程。

words.def: a rule or safeguard that keeps a system or person from going too far
words.mn: Gemini 這輛自己開的車旁，公路邊立著護欄，掛著 pause、stop、approve 三個牌子，游標小車一撞上就被彈回車道。擋住你衝出路外的欄杆，就是防護機制。
words.ex: The bank added guardrails so no single trader can place huge bets.
words.exZh: 銀行加了防護機制，避免單一交易員下巨額賭注。

quiz.q: The founder was exhausted, so her co-founder agreed to ___ for the product launch.
quiz.why: take the wheel 是接手掌控。pull the plug 是終止計畫，steal the show 是搶走風采。

quiz.q: The school set clear ___ on how students may use AI tools in essays.
quiz.why: guardrails 是防護規範。loopholes 是漏洞，tripwires 是觸發警報的絆線，不是用來限制範圍的規則。
